item.title: Ask HN: Early Feedback on Dez?
item.summary: Hi all I am building a open source ide based on zed it's nothing too fancy but I( along with codex)have been working on it for 1 month now I would like genuine feedback and contributions if needed. The current version is v 0.4 and I will release it officially on show hn for v 1.0. I am asking for guidance so I can move forward with a Direction.
